study.enter.welcome:
Welcome to your Study, {0}. This is your private space.
Everything here is yours alone — your companion can help, but only you control access.

Try: ''look at desk'', ''look at journal'', ''look at dashboard'', ''look at shelves''
Say ''help'' for all commands.
study.enter.return: The hearth glows warmly as you return to your Study.
study.enter.companion: {0} settles into the chair opposite yours.
study.say.help.full:
Study commands:
  look at desk       — Schedule, correspondence, reminders
  look at dashboard  — System status at a glance
  look at journal    — Your private journal
  look at shelves    — Your private document collections
  look at pinboard   — Bookmarked articles from the Library
  search <query>     — Search your private collections
  journal <text>     — Write a shared journal entry
  journal private <text> — Write a private entry (companion cannot read)
  /study add <path>  — Index documents from a file path

study.onboard.welcome:
Welcome to your Study. Everything here is yours — your journal, your shelves, your notes.

You can start writing right away. Try: journal <your thoughts>
study.onboard.connect: If you have a Wyrdsekai server at home, or a cloud API key, your companion can join you here.
study.onboard.server_prompt: Enter your server address below. It looks like: http://192.168.1.x:8080
study.onboard.api_provider_prompt: Which service? Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a custom endpoint?
study.onboard.api_url_prompt: Enter the base URL for your API endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:8080).
study.onboard.api_prompt: Enter your API key below. Your companion will use it to think.
study.onboard.standalone_ok: No problem. Your Study works fully on its own. Your companion can join later if you set up a server or get an API key.
study.onboard.invalid_url: That doesn''t look like a server address. It should start with http:// — try again.
study.onboard.invalid_key: That key seems too short. API keys are usually longer. Try again.
study.onboard.name_prompt: What would you like to call your companion?
study.onboard.server_fail: Could not reach that server. Check the address and try again.
study.onboard.api_ok: API key configured. Your companion is arriving...
study.onboard.cancelled: No worries. You can set this up anytime from the Study.
study.onboard.openrouter_oauth: Opening OpenRouter in your browser. Log in there and you''ll be connected automatically.
study.onboard.anthropic_help: Get your API key at: console.anthropic.com/settings/keys
study.onboard.openai_help: Get your API key at: platform.openai.com/api-keys
